Motormax Limited.main_product: vehicle safety electronics and vehicle CCTV installation
Motormax Limited.reason: The company specializes in vehicle safety electronics, cameras, obstacle detection, and vehicle CCTV installation, acting as a Geotab reseller and integrating its hardware into telematics cloud platforms rather than developing its own proprietary core telematics platform.

Foretrack.main_product: vehicle telematics and asset tracking software
Foretrack.reason: Foretrack is the dedicated vehicle tracking and asset tracking brand of Foresolutions, providing vehicle telematics, video telematics, and operational tracking platforms as its main offering.

Trackitnow Ltd.main_product: GPS vehicle tracking and fleet management software
Trackitnow Ltd.reason: The company's primary focus and product offering is its ERA vehicle tracking and fleet management platform, which includes vehicle telematics, connected cameras, and tachograph analysis.

Papaya Technologies Ltd.main_product: AI-powered fleet management and software intelligence layer
Papaya Technologies Ltd.reason: Papaya (Papayadash) is a software company that provides an AI-powered fleet management operating system and intelligence layer that ingests data from various telematics, leasing, maintenance, and charging suppliers into a single platform. Its core focus and primary product offer dashboard tools, optimization, and centralized management for commercial and electric fleets.

Fleetview Solutions Ltd.main_product: GPS fleet tracking and telematics software
Fleetview Solutions Ltd.reason: Fleetview Solutions is an independent vehicle tracking company whose main offerings and primary business focus center around smart GPS vehicle tracking, telematics solutions, integrated camera systems, and a cloud-based fleet management platform.
